label: Остаться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for остаться (to stay, remain).

missions.phrase: Я останусь дома на все выходные.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. Остаться is perfective and reflexive, so 'останусь' is the non-past 1sg form with future meaning, built on stem остан- plus the particle -сь. The imperfective partner is оставаться.

missions.phrase: Ты останешься со мной до утра?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Останешься' shows the -ешься ending on stem остан-. As a perfective non-past it asks about one act of staying, with the reflexive particle -ся after the consonant.

missions.phrase: Он останется в городе ещё неделю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Останется' is the он-form ending in -ется. The perfective marks a single bounded period of staying, contrasting with the ongoing остаётся from оставаться.

missions.phrase: Мы останемся здесь до конца концерта.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Останемся' carries the -емся ending on остан-. The perfective frames one decision to remain until a fixed endpoint rather than a habit.

missions.phrase: Вы останетесь на ужин сегодня вечером?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Останетесь' trains the respectful вы-form with -етесь on остан-. The reflexive particle becomes -сь after the vowel, asking about one act of staying.

missions.phrase: Они останутся в деревне на лето.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Останутся' closes the non-past ladder with the -утся ending on остан-. The perfective marks a single future stay for the whole summer.

missions.phrase: Он остался один в пустой квартире.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Остался' is the masculine singular past of perfective остаться, with the reflexive particle -ся after the -л. It reports one completed result of being left alone.

missions.phrase: Она осталась довольна своей новой работой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Осталась' adds the feminine -ась ending. The perfective past names a finished outcome, here остаться plus the short adjective 'довольна' to mean she ended up pleased.

Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Остались' is the plural past ending in -ись, completing the past forms. The perfective marks one completed arrangement of the children being left in their grandmother's care.

Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Останься' is the informal command form on stem остан- with the reflexive -ся, asking one person to stay a little longer. The polite 'прошу тебя' softens the request.
